rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the interior surface of a room or building.

example.english: The children are playing on the floor.
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 hai2 dei6 baan2 soeng6 min6 waan2

rows.note: Use this for a storey or level of a building, as in the third floor.

example.english: Our company is on the tenth floor.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai2 sap6 lau4

rows.note: Use this for the ground or land surface, rather than an indoor floor or a building storey.

example.english: When hiking, the forest floor is very slippery.
example.traditional: 行山嗰陣，森林嘅地面好跣。
example.jyutping: haang4 saan1 go2 zan6 sam1 lam4 ge3 dei6 min6 hou2 sin2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the area where people dance.

example.english: As soon as we got in, everyone went straight onto the dance floor.
example.traditional: 入場之後，大家即刻喺舞池跳舞。
example.jyutping: jap6 coeng4 zi1 hau6 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 hai2 mou5 ci4 tiu3 mou5
